description: This file implements a proxy resolver for macOS, utilizing CFNetwork APIs to determine proxy settings for URLs, including handling PAC files and synchronizing run loop events.

classes.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver
classes.description: A run loop observer that synchronizes execution of CFNetwork proxy auto-configuration sources using a lock.

classes.name: ProxyResolverMac
classes.description: A proxy resolver implementation for macOS that uses CFNetwork to resolve proxies for URLs.

methods.name: GetProxyServerScheme
methods.description: Maps CFProxyType to ProxyServer::Scheme, returning SCHEME_INVALID for unknown types.

methods.name: ResultCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked by CFNetwork to store proxy resolution results or errors.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::SynchronizedRunLoopObserver
methods.description: Constructor that creates a CFRunLoopObserver to synchronize run loop events.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::~SynchronizedRunLoopObserver
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the run loop observer.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::AddToCurrentRunLoop
methods.description: Adds the observer to the current run loop in a specified mode.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::RemoveFromCurrentRunLoop
methods.description: Removes the observer from the current run loop in a specified mode.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::RunLoopObserverCallBack
methods.description: Handles run loop activity and manages lock acquisition/release.

methods.name: ProxyResolverMac::GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Resolves proxy settings for a URL using CFNetwork's PAC support, handling synchronization and error cases.
